body:
This is my first ever Minecraft mod, made with MCreator. It’s a bit chaotic and probably pretty unbalanced, but that’s part of the fun. The mod adds a bunch of random and silly content that I thought would be cool or funny to include while learning how modding works.

The mod currently includes

New guns and weapons
Several custom swords, including a Lapis Sword
New biomes to explore
Food items like burgers and pizza
Random joke items, including poop
Lots of strange and unexpected features
new armor op and not

Some things may be buggy or unfinished since this is still my first project, but I’m continuing to learn and improve the mod over time. If you download it, expect randomness, weird ideas, and a lot of experimentation.
you dont need any other mods
